text:
kelly_marketing: Heads-up: planning to announce Release Phoenix next Thurs 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs URL, short benchmark bullet for the blog, and confirmation of canary + ramp windows. Also locking a 30-min webinar the same day at 11am PT. Who's demoing? :sparkles:

sam_eng: I can push the changelog. Draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/499 (final sha `7a9f3d`). Canary plan: 09:00 PT canary for 7m, 25% at 09:07, 60% at 09:15, full at 09:30. Fallback tag is `phoenix-legacy`. Ops on standby.

priya_docs: Staging docs are up: https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/phoenix. I'll paste the migration example soon. Marketing, need a one-line hero sentence to lead the quickstart page.

kelly_marketing: Ok. Webinar: Evan, you to lead? Nico to cover benchmark slides, Priya to demo migration. Email send to go ~5m after full rollout. Thoughts?

ev an_pm: Yep I'll lead. I'll prep a 12-slide deck and coordinate Q&A with Nico. Locking webinar slot 11:00 PT. I'll own the runbook and the rollback steps.

nico_research: Benchmark blurb candidate: "Phoenix delivers ~2.1x token-cost savings on sparse long-context workloads and lowers 95th pct latency by ~45% at 16k tokens." Running one more validation overnight; will confirm by 8am PT tomorrow.

kelly_marketing: Love it. Please confirm the exact percent by 8am so we can freeze numbers.

sam_eng: Regression queued. Also note the canary flips a new quant-kernel flag; add post-rollout check to validate p50/p95 for the default model route. Runbook snippet I'll add: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=reinference` and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=2` if needed.

priya_docs: Migration snippet (to paste into docs):

```
# example phoenix config
model:
  id: redwood-phoenix
  quant_mode: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
```

kelly_marketing: Timeline I'm proposing: 09:00 PT canary start, 09:30 full rollout, 09:35 public blog + docs link, 09:40 email blast, 11:00 webinar (live). Marketing will publish the announcement draft here by EOD for review.

ev an_pm: Sounds good. I'll publish the runbook link in this thread when ready and include the exact health-check commands for the oncall to run.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release-phoenix start=5523456720 canary_window=7m full_rollout=5523457000. CI: all checks green. :white_check_mark:

kelly_marketing: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: changelog PR merged, staging docs URL, benchmark confirmation, runbook + rollback commands, webinar deck. Ping this thread with any last-minute changes. :raised_hands:
